name: Make
description: Run and inspect Make scenarios — the automations you already built there.
long_description:
Make's own server, run as a local process. It lists your scenarios, runs one and reads what came back, so an automation you already built is a tool the agent can call.

It needs an API key with the `scenarios:read` and `scenarios:run` scopes, plus your zone and team.

auth.instructions: Create an API key in your Make profile with the `scenarios:read` and `scenarios:run` scopes, and paste it here.

risk.notes: Runs your Make scenarios, which do whatever you built them to do — including sending things to other people.

MAKE_ZONE.title: Zone
MAKE_ZONE.description: The host your Make organisation is on, e.g. eu2.make.com

MAKE_TEAM.title: Team ID
MAKE_TEAM.description: The number in the URL of your Make team page
